meta.title: How adidas Stan Smiths Lost Me a Girlfriend.
meta.description:
Did you know you have a higher chance of seeing my videos if you SUBSCRIBE. And follow me on IG? @8thWeekday 

Yes I know the 'a' in adidas is small but I think that's how they like it. I was gonna make it big and then I didn't. SO instead of doing a review on my Stan Smiths I figured I'd tell you the story behind the best white shoes for spring summer fall and winter 2021 2022 and forever. Do you want a micro review of these sneakers? Okay here we go: the best white sneakers are the Stan Smiths. I like the white color of them. Do they age well? Eh...kinda, not really I mean if they were full grain leather or drum dyed I'm sure they would but then the price would really start to go up higher into Common Projects range (which are a great sneaker). HOWEVER these sneakers are…not leather. Even in their flagship store I had a tough time finding the leather one (and now they are more expensive). I’ll let you know how they age though don’t worry. Their silhouette is unmatched in my opinion though and I'm glad I have a new pair to wear and break in!

Side note: I saw adidas' human made line and those are some high quality pieces! I was going to get some stuff from the line but then figured I'd save the money so I can afford producing my own clothing line. Then I saw the Kermit line and had to do the same thing...then I saw some cool socks...
